card.title: Choose the Relationship
card.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let work ring. I'd like to finish choosing our wedding vows with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The client won't sign unless I'm there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm about to promise you my whole life. Could I have ten minutes before the client?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask Maya to cover. She'll want a reason.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her we're making promises too. Put ours in your calendar beside the client's.

mechanism: A asks B to prioritize shared wedding promises over a client demand and make that priority visible in the schedule.
confusable: Unlike merely asking for quiet, A must place the connection in competition with a real outside obligation.
comparison: D82-a accepts work cover but wants the reason named; D82-b rejects postponing a meaningful dinner again.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
